source.testPolicy: Cooling nearest 26 C; automatic fan when available, otherwise actual source fan. Gree uses original paired quick-match codes.
source.validation: Offline encoder/reference validation; each appliance still requires physical matching.

control.policy: Enumerate existing source mode/fan/temperature keys; source encoders generate IR. Exact key lookup bypasses only source UI temperature rounding. No inferred Cartesian combinations.
control.xiaomiFixedFields: Dry fan is mode-managed (wire 0x0F); fan_only temperature is not applicable (wire 0x20). These bytes are not claims of physical fan level 2 or a 24 C setpoint.
